title: Landing page loads with hero title
description: Verify the landing page loads and shows the hero title containing 'Escrow'

steps.description: Navigate to http://localhost:3001
Verify an h1 element is visible
Verify the h1 text contains 'Escrow'
Verify a text input with placeholder containing 'milestone hash' is visible

title: Navigation links are visible and functional
description: Verify all navigation links are present in the header

steps.description: Navigate to http://localhost:3001
Verify a link with text 'Explorer' is visible
Verify a link with text 'Operations' is visible
Verify a link with text 'Sponsor' is visible
Verify a link with text 'Activity' is visible
Verify a link with text 'Verifiers' is visible

title: Explorer page loads with milestone table
description: Verify the Explorer page loads and shows a table of milestones

steps.description: Navigate to http://localhost:3001/explorer
Verify the page title contains 'Explorer' or 'milestone'
Verify a table element is visible or milestone cards are shown
Verify at least one milestone row or card is visible

title: Explorer filter buttons work
description: Verify the status filter buttons are visible on the Explorer page

steps.description: Navigate to http://localhost:3001/explorer
Verify filter buttons are visible (All, Verified, Pending)

title: Operations dashboard loads with KPIs
description: Verify the Operations page loads and shows KPI cards

steps.description: Navigate to http://localhost:3001/operations
Verify the page title contains 'operations' or 'open books'
Verify KPI cards or values are visible
Verify a Refresh button is visible

title: Sponsor dashboard loads with capital flow
description: Verify the Sponsor page loads and shows capital flow data

steps.description: Navigate to http://localhost:3001/sponsor
Verify the page title contains 'capital'
Verify KPI cards are visible
Verify a Refresh button is visible

title: Activity feed loads with timeline
description: Verify the Activity page loads and shows a timeline of events

steps.description: Navigate to http://localhost:3001/activity
Verify the page title contains 'timestamped' or 'activity'
Verify timeline events are visible
Verify a Refresh button is visible

title: Verifier network page loads
description: Verify the Verifiers page loads and shows verifier network data

steps.description: Navigate to http://localhost:3001/verifiers
Verify the page title contains 'swarm' or 'verifier'
Verify KPI cards are visible
Verify a Refresh button is visible

title: API docs page loads
description: Verify the API documentation page loads and shows endpoint documentation

steps.description: Navigate to http://localhost:3001/api/docs
Verify the page contains 'API' or 'endpoint'
Verify at least one endpoint is documented on the page

title: Recovery page loads with timeline
description: Verify the Recovery page loads and shows the chaos recovery demo

steps.description: Navigate to http://localhost:3001/operations
Verify the page loads without error
Verify recovery-related content is visible

title: Builder lookup page loads
description: Verify the Builder lookup page loads with a search input

steps.description: Navigate to http://localhost:3001/builder/weft.thisyearnofear.eth
Verify the page loads without error
Verify a search input or lookup form is visible

title: All pages return HTTP 200
description: Verify all main pages return HTTP 200 status code

steps.description: Navigate to http://localhost:3001/
Verify the page loads successfully (no error page)
Navigate to http://localhost:3001/explorer
Verify the page loads successfully
Navigate to http://localhost:3001/operations
Verify the page loads successfully
